name: Mari
notes: Mari (марий йылме), the ISO 639-3 macrolanguage node covering the Mari branch of Uralic spoken in the Mari El Republic and surrounding regions of Russia. Mari has no single standard: it comprises the individual languages Meadow/Eastern Mari (mhr.json) and Hill Mari / Western Mari (mrj.json), each with its own Cyrillic-based literary norm and its own JSON spec in this dataset. This node is classification-only (clade=true, empty graphemes/allophones) — it asserts no orthography of its own and must not be inherited from; mhr and mrj each point their `parent` at this node.
